01 / OBJECT OF ART — THE FLACON SYSTEM

One Architectural Silhouette. Two Tactile Executions.

Engineered as a monolithic prism with chamfered vertical ribs and a deep optical glass punt, every ZARYA flacon places the standalone Kashmiri hangul on the upper facade—never enclosed within a shield, crest, or decorative frame—while the ZARYA wordmark rests much lower above the base.

EXECUTION A — GRAND HERITAGE EDITION

Smoked Obsidian Glass & High-Relief Antique Brass

Designed for high-concentration Extraits and reserve compositions. The full-bodied Kashmiri hangul stag is cast in hand-patinated antique brass relief and bonded directly onto heavy smoked-obsidian glass—without any shield, crest, or plaque border.

Cap Geometry
Weighty octagonal brushed antique brass with vertical architectural fluting & top-struck Hangul seal (148g).
Hangul Execution
Standalone full-body standing stag in bas-relief antique brass on the upper glass facade (zero framing).
Glass Architecture
Thick-walled smoked obsidian flint glass with 45° bevelled vertical ribs and a 14mm optical base punt.
Wordmark Placement
Separated by 38mm of clear vertical glass below the stag's hooves; etched in spaced classic serif capitals.
Stag Legibility Across Scales

100 ml Flacon Front Facade (42 mm Height)

Full copperplate cross-hatching and 10-point antler tines remain crisp at arm's length.

THE MASTER EMBLEM • CERVUS HANGLU HANGLU

Why the Kashmiri Hangul Stands Unframed

Rendered in the manner of a 19th-century natural-history copperplate engraving, the hangul stag is never confined inside a shield, royal crest, or floral scroll. Its quiet posture and generous separation from the ZARYA wordmark embody self-assured permanence.

03 / THE HOUSE — ZARYA INDUSTRIES (INDIA)

Old-World Prestige. Contemporary Indian Discipline.

Zarya Industries is an India-based enterprise conceived with a singular primary focus: establishing a house of fine perfumery that draws quiet material and atmospheric inspiration from Kashmir—its high-altitude mist, weathered Himalayan limestone, dark deodar timber, and archival natural-history illustration.

Rather than imitating European court heraldry or ornate souvenir motifs, ZARYA translates the discipline of haute parfumerie into heavy glass, brushed metal, and honest botanical storytelling.

05 / DISCOVERY, GIFTING & ATELIER SERVICES

The Archival Discovery Coffret & Presentation

Designed for unhurried skin testing across changing temperatures and hours. Each coffret houses five 2 ml glass atomizers in a charcoal linen cradle alongside heavy cotton-rag blotter strips blind-stamped with the Kashmiri hangul.

THE FIVE-STUDY ARCHIVAL COFFRET (5 × 2 ML) STATUS: PLANNED FORMAT [CONFIRM PRICING]

The Discovery Pledge

Every future full-size flacon includes a matching 2 ml sample vial so the outer cotton-rag seal can be experienced on skin before opening the main box.

Kagzi Gift Wrapping

Wrapped in textured bone-ivory cotton paper, secured with a dark charcoal wax impression and an unframed hangul botanical card.

Trade & Formulation

Open to verified discussions with raw-material growers, glassmakers, contract formulators, and commercial partners across India and abroad.
